crossRefs.note: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”
“I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into…
for our God is a consuming fire.

translations.web: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?
translations.bsb: No, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both ends, and the middle is charred. Can it be useful for anything?
translations.kjv: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
translations.asv: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned: is it profitable for any work?
